environment.description: Same EKS cluster but namespace has a Cilium-enforced network policy. The cluster uses Cilium 1.14 as CNI with policy enforcement mode 'always'. A CiliumNetworkPolicy resource in the namespace specifies default-deny egress with explicit allowances only for TCP/5432 to the RDS security group CIDR (10.0.128.0/20) and UDP/53 to kube-dns (cluster IP 172.20.0.10). The policy uses entity-based rules with 'toFQDNs' not configured for the link-local range. Additionally, the node has a host-level iptables FORWARD chain rule inserted by the cluster bootstrap (priority before Cilium) that drops packets from pod CIDR to 169.254.0.0/16 with comment 'metadata-guard-legacy'. IMDSv2 is configured with hop-limit=1 but this alone would not block from pods on the same node in all configurations.
